E08_R138_RESULT: ASSOCIATION CONTROL RESOLVED; OUTER-FRONT MHD FAMILY NOT IDENTIFIED
observer_facing_result: The outer front crosses the spectrometer sampling geometry. The strong later spectrum belongs to the erupting filament and must not be used as the front plasma state.
imaging_structure: Weak outer propagating EUV front, separated from compression/dimming and erupting filament in the source analysis.
spectroscopic_structure: Strong later CDS/SUMER transition-region components: eruptive filament. Earlier outer-front passage: instrument-conditioned non-detection.
spectroscopy_constrains_outer_family: Not sufficiently for FAST/SLOW selection. It constrains the recorded response under the actual exposure and line sensitivity.
prevents: Combining outer-front image kinematics with filament Doppler shifts or blended hot-line emission into one fictitious MHD state; treating a non-detection as proof of no wave.
minimum_next_observation: A time-resolved, spatially registered, blend-controlled coronal spectrum of the outer-front passage itself, with a bounded front-emission contribution and calibrated sensitivity. MHD selection additionally requires sufficient local upstream/downstream state and geometry constraints.
precision_reason: No measured local state domain or front-emission lower bound supports a numerical requirement in this control.
scope: Published-source and retained-record association control; no raw solar data reprocessing.
